title: Satisfied and unsatisfied indicators sum to one
statement: Let a constraint template on a set $D$ specify a finite family of predicates with arities and Boolean evaluations, and let $c$ be one of its constraints on a set of variables. For every assignment of values in $D$ to the variables, the constraint’s satisfied indicator plus its unsatisfied indicator equals $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A constraint template on $D$ is given
$c$ is a constraint for that template
An assignment from variables to $D$ is given
